gemini.title: River Net Routes
gemini.abstract: River Net Routes is an authoritative dataset published by Environmental Protection Agency Ireland. It represents river net routes features using linestring geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by the Environmental Protection Agency Ireland as open environmental data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
